desc: Ambedkar Chowk metro station, formerly called Agra Fort is the under-ground station of the Yellow Line of the Agra Metro. It provides connectivity with Agra Fort. This station is owned by the Uttar Pradesh Metro Rail Corporation , and was opened to the public on 6 March 2024.
